title: Persistence
subtitle: Local draft and cache survival
description: Debounced localStorage/sessionStorage (or custom db) for mid-edit drafts.

callouts.title: Requires a key
callouts.content: When persist is enabled, provide a stable `key` (or `persist.key`) so drafts from different entities do not collide.

content: Persist is for local survival — not an offline mutation queue.

sections.title: Draft persist
sections.content: Writes overrides to storage while dirty; clears on successful save; hydrates on create:

sections.title: Cache persist
sections.content: `persist: true` enables both draft and source cache. Cache stores successful fetch/save payloads under `{key}:cache`.

sections.title: Custom storage
sections.content: Pass `storage` (get/set/remove) or `db` (get/set/del, e.g. qortex-db) plus `onError` for quota failures.

sections.title: What it is not
sections.content:
• Not multi-tab sync
• Not encrypted
• Not a retry queue for failed saves
• Hydration is async — no dedicated `hydrating` status in alpha
